content:
Blend at high speed:

  • 3/4 cup + 1 T lemon juice

  • 1/8 cup Braggs

  • 1 T water

  • 3 cloves garlic

  • 2 t ground yellow mustard seeds

  • 1/8 t cayenne

    • While blending slowly add:

    • 3/4 cup of oil blend: olive, flax, hemp

      • This dressing is thick and creamy and will last in the refrigerator for two weeks.
